summary: Final report BW11_0275 for Avernelwick Pharmaceuticals Ltd: hERG automated patch clamp, 5-isoform CYP panel on 40 compounds (Aminopyrimidine regioisomer). Study summary (benchmark) table on page 1; full compound tables, methods and control results follow.

title_block.title: AP02 hinge-binder triage: hERG and five-CYP panel, 40 analogues
title_block.subtitle: Final Report

blocks.p: 40 compounds from the Avernelwick aminopyrimidine regioisomer series 02 were tested for Avernelwick Pharmaceuticals Ltd in the hERG automated patch clamp, 5-isoform CYP panel. Testing started on 12 September 2011 and results were reported on 27 September 2011. All runs met plate acceptance criteria. No compound inhibited hERG with an IC50 below 1 µM. The set split between the 1-10 µM band and compounds at or above 10 µM. Inhibition above 50% at 10 µM was most frequent for CYP3A4; CYP1A2, CYP2C9 were rarely affected.
To rank the screening set for hERG automated patch clamp, 5-isoform CYP panel liability so that Avernelwick Pharmaceuticals Ltd could choose analogues for progression.
40 compounds were received as 10 mM DMSO solutions in one test lot on 12 September 2011 and logged against B-ACC-2011-04692. Identity and concentration were taken as supplied by the client.

HEK293 cells stably expressing hERG (Kv11.1) were recorded in whole-cell configuration on a 16-channel automated patch clamp platform at room temperature. Cells were held at -80 mV, depolarised to +40 mV for 2 s and repolarised to -50 mV for 2 s to elicit the tail current, at 0.1 Hz. Each compound was applied cumulatively at 0.12, 0.37, 1.1, 3.3, 10 and 30 µM (0.3% DMSO final), with 3-5 minutes per concentration.

list: Plate acceptance: seal resistance ≥500 MΩ before break-in and ≥200 MΩ throughout
Tail current amplitude ≥200 pA at baseline; run-down ≤10% over the vehicle period
Positive control E-4031 on every run; IC50 must fall within 5-50 nM
IC50 from a four-parameter logistic fit of mean tail-current inhibition; n≥2 cells per compound

blocks.p: Pooled human liver microsomes (0.1 mg/mL protein) were incubated with each compound at 10 µM and an isoform-selective probe substrate at approximately Km, in duplicate, for 10 minutes at 37 °C after NADPH addition. Metabolite formation was measured by LC-MS/MS against vehicle (0.1% DMSO) incubations.
Results are reported as mean percent inhibition relative to vehicle. Values above 50% at 10 µM are flagged for follow-up; small negative values indicate no inhibition.

All {{PRJ0001:herg.n_tested}} compounds were tested. No compound inhibited hERG with an IC50 below 1 µM. The set split between the 1-10 µM band and compounds at or above 10 µM. The median IC50 was {{PRJ0001:herg.median_ic50_uM}} µM ({{PRJ0001:herg.n_lt_1uM}} below 1 µM, {{PRJ0001:herg.n_1_10uM}} between 1 and 10 µM, {{PRJ0001:herg.n_ge_10uM}} at or above 10 µM). E-4031 gave an IC50 of {{PRJ0001:herg.control_e4031_nM}} nM, within the acceptance range.

Inhibition above 50% at 10 µM was most frequent for CYP3A4; CYP1A2, CYP2C9 were rarely affected. In total {{PRJ0001:cyp.n_any_gt50}} compounds inhibited at least one isoform by more than 50% at 10 µM (CYP3A4: {{PRJ0001:cyp.n_gt50_CYP3A4}}; CYP2D6: {{PRJ0001:cyp.n_gt50_CYP2D6}}; CYP2C19: {{PRJ0001:cyp.n_gt50_CYP2C19}}; CYP2C9: {{PRJ0001:cyp.n_gt50_CYP2C9}}; CYP1A2: {{PRJ0001:cyp.n_gt50_CYP1A2}}). Ketoconazole inhibited CYP3A4 with an IC50 of {{PRJ0001:cyp.control_CYP3A4_uM}} µM.

No compound inhibited hERG with an IC50 below 1 µM. The set split between the 1-10 µM band and compounds at or above 10 µM. Inhibition above 50% at 10 µM was most frequent for CYP3A4; CYP1A2, CYP2C9 were rarely affected. These are screening data; binding-site and mechanism statements are outside the scope of this study.
The data support ranking within the set. Recommended next step: progress the compounds with the widest hERG margin and no CYP flag, and confirm any CYP3A4 flags by concentration response.
